meaning: Conservative routing trial ceilings and protective policy caps, not intrinsic model scores or permission grants.
unassessed_semantics: A null ceiling means no evidence-backed route in that domain. It is not zero capability and must not be coerced to numeric zero.
controlled_sanity_test: Six available requested targets tied on three narrow tasks; the operator-recorded test did not differentiate ceilings or independently establish backend identity.

global_autonomy_constraints: An unassessed domain is no_route, not numeric zero and not a protective permission.
No model receives autonomous acceptance for MATH-7 through MATH-9 or PHY-7 through PHY-9.
SE autonomy applies only to low-risk reversible tasks with independent tests and policy gates.
Authentication, cryptography, billing, data migration, deployment, security approval, and safety-critical work require human review regardless of numeric ceiling.
A model ceiling never broadens sandbox, connector, filesystem, network, or approval authority.
